text:
jane-support: Customer reported a weird routing issue after a tool rename. Calls intended for `orderProcess` are sometimes reaching `order_process_v1` and returning schema validation 400s. Happens intermittently, spike started ~2h ago.

devon-eng: Do we know if this is a client-side alias or server/registry drift? Any tenant-specific pattern?

sre-anna: Saw similar alerts. Looks like proxy cache returned an older handle for some requests. Metrics: a bump in 404->400 handoffs for tenant `acme-inc` in us-east-1.

elena-platform: Registry sync logs show delayed propagation for the rename job between primary and read replicas for ~12m at 1709999999-1710000715. Could be stale reads from regional replicas.

jane-support: Customer repro steps they sent: POST /v1/tools/call with body {"tool": "orderProcess", "args": {...}} -> sometimes 400 response {"error":"tool schema mismatch","expected":"v2","received":"v1"}

devon-eng: Can you paste a raw request id from a failed call? Need trace to see which proxy and which registry snapshot served it.

jane-support: Request IDs: r-3fa2c, r-3fb9d, r-3fc01 (attached logs). All from us-east-1, mixed times in the 2h window.

registry-bot: INFO: rename job order_process_v1 -> orderProcess applied at 1711108800 on primary; replication to us-east-1 replica completed at 1711109450.

oncall-luis: I'm going to tail the proxy cache for us-east nodes and trigger a cache flush for the tenant. Will monitor for reoccurrence.

sre-anna: Quick workaround: tenant-specific cache purge should fix most hits. Longer-term we should avoid opaque case-normalization differences between handles and registry keys.

devon-eng: Repro on staging: run this sequence ->
```
# create alias
POST /admin/registry/rename {"from":"order_process_v1","to":"orderProcess"}
# immediately call
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.dev/v1/tools/call -d '{"tool":"orderProcess","args":{}}' -H 'x-tenant: acme'
```
I see ~30% of calls hit old handle for ~90s if replica hasn't caught up.

elena-platform: Root cause summary hypothesis: rename applied on primary, proxies in region still reading old replica snapshot until replication completes -> proxy cache stores stale mapping -> intermittent misrouting + schema errors.

jane-support: Customer wants ETA; they hit production errors impacting order flows. They've escalated to their account team.

oncall-luis: Immediate action: purged tenant cache on us-east proxies at 1711112800 and forced registry read-through for subsequent requests. Asking customer to validate now.

jane-support: Customer confirms a drop in errors after the purge. Still want a post-mortem and a safer rollout path. :relieved:

devon-eng: Next steps: (1) add a read-after-write fence for rename ops for affected regions, (2) add short TTL and randomized jitter to proxy handle cache during rollouts, (3) add a monitoring alert for rename-replication-lag. I'll open a runtime ticket and tag eng-runtime.

elena-platform: Also going to add a registry job check that waits for replica ack before marking rename as complete in the control plane.

sre-anna: Logging action items in incident tracker. Assigning follow-ups to devon-eng (runtime), elena-platform (replication), oncall-luis (runbook update).

jane-support: Thanks team — relaying to the customer and scheduling a 1:1 postmortem with the account lead.
